```{r base_wm}
message("m1")
warning("w1")
message("m2")
warning("w2")
```

```{r warn_false, warning=FALSE}
warning("dropped warning")
print("x")
```

```{r warn_na, warning=NA}
warning("na warning")
print("y")
```

```{r msg_false, message=FALSE}
message("dropped message")
print("z")
```

```{r msg_na, message=NA}
message("na message")
print("w")
```

```{r warn_num, warning=1}
warning("first")
warning("second")
```

```{r msg_num, message=2}
message("one\n")
message("two\n")
message("three\n")
```
